name: render-split-screen-creator
description: Assemble a split-screen creator ad from a config: an AI-creator lip-sync take fills the bottom half while real 16:9 product or demo clips play uncropped in the top half over a blurred fill of the same clip (never black bars), with a brand-colour divider between them. Scenes follow the voiceover timing and are joined hard, an end card holds about 3 seconds, then the finished cut is transcribed and word-level captions are burned in the chosen style. Free, deterministic assembly and captions; the voiceover comes from create-vo-elevenlabs, the creator anchor from create-image-gpt-image-fal, and the lip-sync take is supplied as an input. Use for the split-screen-creator format.
